newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Credit Lyonnais executive stabbed dead in China.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais executive stabbed dead in China.

text.p: A Hong Kong executive with the French bank Credit Lyonnais was found stabbed to death last week in a hotel room in eastern China, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
Kevin Kong, 31, died of multiple stab wounds on Thursday in his hotel room in Guixi, Jiangxi province, the spokeswoman said.

Kong, the father of a baby girl, who was found dead just hours before his company was due to sign a multimillion-dollar loan agreement with a Chinese company, had also been robbed of his wallet, the South China Morning Post reported.
The newspaper identified the mainland company as Jiangxi Copper, China's largest copper producer.
